name: Prismwell: Light Path Puzzle
subtitle: Bend beams, light every goal
shortDescription: A glowing optics table, sixty hand-tuned puzzles and a new daily table every day. Steer coloured light with mirrors, gels and prisms.
longDescription:
A beam of light leaves its source. Somewhere on the table a ring waits for exactly that colour. Between them is a handful of glass and metal, and it is your job to arrange it.

Prismwell puts you in front of a softly lit optics table in real-time 3D. Tap a part, drop it on a square, turn it, and watch every beam redraw at once. When each receiver glows the colour it asked for, the puzzle is done.

### The Parts
- Mirrors turn a beam a quarter turn.
- Half-silvered mirrors let light through and bounce it at the same time, so one beam can feed two goals.
- Colour gels take colours away: white through a yellow gel leaves only red and green.
- Prisms fan white light into red, green and blue, each leaving in its own direction.
- Light also adds. Red plus green lands as yellow, and a receiver only accepts the exact colour it shows.

### What You Get
- 60 puzzles in six benches, from a single mirror to a three-source table with blocks in the way.
- A new daily puzzle built from the date, with a streak calendar. Everyone gets the same table.
- Stars for finishing at par, and a hint that points at one correct part when you are stuck.
- A free-build light lab with every part, colour meters and a saved bench.
- Six short optics lessons with live demonstrations: reflection, half-silvered mirrors, gels, adding light, prisms and a solving method.
- Letters on every receiver (R, G, B) so colour is never the only clue.
- A- and A+ text size on every screen, and support for your system text size.
- Works fully offline. No account.

Every puzzle is machine-checked so that a solution exists and every part in the tray is needed.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
